The '''Cliffside Tunnel Network''' was a series of tunnels located beneath the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruhnuk]]. The network connected together the [[Hollow Chasm]], the [[Dilapidated Waterworks]] and the [[Overgrown Mining Site]].<ref name="TOR" />
